integrity: Complete symbolic proof; exhaustive compatible-relation closure enumeration for four small groups and constructive checks for S3; computations do not substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Two-level direct product with identity connecting map; not general Clifford semigroups or infinite groups.
Density exponent is for fixed prime and increasing elementary-abelian rank.
Historical priority not independently certified; general congruence portion has pre-existing theory.
title: Diagonal compatible relations and the sharp density exponent for two-level Clifford monoids
